title: Field-scale investigation of infiltration into a compacted soil liner

retrieval.scope: Full abstract on USGS; original journal article and raw measurements not obtained

facts.statement: A compacted experimental liner 8 m × 15 m × 0.9 m was flooded in April 1988 and monitored for two years using ring infiltrometers and a water-balance method.
Estimated mean saturated hydraulic conductivity was 4.0e-8 cm/s and 3.4e-8 cm/s in first and second years using small-ring data.

limits: Liner thickness 0.9 m, engineered compaction, and waste-facility design differ from a 0.02 m hand-puddled clay potting pit.
These conductivity values must not be assigned to the island soil.
